DisturbanceSemantics: One issued request is changed before entering the unchanged activation queue. No physical state, parameters or clocks are overwritten.
Selection: Complete strict finishes first. Compare worst development time, clearance and sustained speed. Prefer 0.55 m when within 0.15 s of the fastest eligible development candidate. Also show 0.52 and 0.59 m targets. Never use fresh or registered nonnominal results to tune.
